note: Recorded state of every migration in ops/migrations/. Migrations on this project are applied by hand and this file is the only place that says which ones have been. A state is a claim about the live database that a human established and can defend in a diff — never something this repository inferred for itself. States: applied (carries appliedOn — an ISO date, or the literal "unknown" where the date is genuinely unrecoverable), pending (carries reason), unknown (carries reason). "unknown" is a legitimate answer; a guess is not.

Found by scripts/probe-live-tables.mjs; not in the PI-017 inventory, which traced the four operator routes rather than the whole expected-table set. Still unknown, and deliberately so. A live probe of pi_image.review_decisions on 2026-09-14 returned HTTP 406 PGRST106: the pi_image SCHEMA is not exposed through PostgREST. That establishes that the admin image-intelligence page cannot reach it, but it does NOT establish whether this migration ran — a schema can exist in Postgres and be absent from PostgREST's db-schemas setting, and the probe cannot see past the API to tell those apart. Resolving this needs a look at the database itself, not another probe. Recording the probe result here rather than promoting it to "pending" is the point of having three states.

pi.corrections probed against the live PostgREST endpoint on 2026-09-14 returned HTTP 404. Shipped as PI-016 (PR #396) on 2026-09-13, so this is plausibly a deploy step not yet taken rather than an old defect — but nothing in the repository could tell those two apart, which is the reason this ledger exists.
